context:
Goal: PR 2701 (solo-batch-hat) is handed in with a review record the merge tool accepts.
Problem (rule): the merge tool refuses the lane's true rounds. A fix verifier passed on the change since the earlier head (35df574 to cfa1ec8a). The tool's remedy asks the lane to post the OLD head's rounds (round 1 FAIL, round 2 FAIL, round 3 PASS) plus a fix check on that change. The lane's own rounds at the new heads were round 1 FAIL, round 2 PASS, round 3 PASS. The auto-mode classifier denied printing the old-rounds record, and only you can lift that denial.
Based on (record): docs/decisions/pr-review-record.md, the restart refusal and the done rules: an earlier record at another head makes a new record restart review unless a fix check on the delta is named.
Based on (ruling): your 774 b granted one exact record command form for one PR (PR 3264) only, so it does not cover this PR or this form (rule outcomes-grant-covers-named-act). Triage read the ruling files only, not the tool's code or the PR.
Departs from: main keeps one round ledger per head; the remedy posts a record that holds the old head's rounds plus a fix check on the change since.
Related, not the same: open item 858 asks whether a passing fix verifier ends review when no round is recorded at its head. Its answer may bear on this one.
The classifier denial stands until you lift it. To accept option a, you can type: "yes, the lane solo-batch-hat may print and post the old-head round record for PR 2701 as merge --review-record's remedy says."
Meanwhile: the lane waits; runner 10 runs the lane lint (no verdict tool in that lane).
Correction 02:06 CST Nov 15 (runner 10's finding, relayed by the coordinator; triage read no code): merge --review-record only PRINTS the record; it posts nothing and has no --confirm flag. "Post" in option a means the lane then posts the printed lines as a PR comment with the GitHub tool. The options and the classifier denial are unchanged.
holds: The lane holds PR 2701 (solo-batch-hat) unrecorded until this is answered.
